questions.q: In a DataFrame with the default index, df.loc[0:2] and df.iloc[0:2] are run. How many rows does each return?
options: loc returns 2 rows and iloc returns 3 rows
loc returns 3 rows and iloc returns 2 rows
questions.explain: loc slices by label and includes the end label, so 0:2 gives three rows. iloc slices by position and excludes the end, so 0:2 gives two rows.

questions.q: Which expression correctly keeps orders with amount above 100 AND status equal to 'shipped'?
questions.explain: Use & to combine boolean Series, and wrap each condition in parentheses because & binds more tightly than > and ==.

questions.q: What is the pandas equivalent of SQL's WHERE status NOT IN ('shipped')?
questions.explain: isin builds the IN mask, and the tilde negates it. The Python keyword not does not work on a Series.

questions.q: Which filter finds rows where amount is missing (SQL's IS NULL)?
questions.explain: isna() flags missing values. Comparing with == to a missing value does not work, because a missing value never equals anything.
